package.description: OFX plugin that removes dirt and dust from film scans, using the neighbouring frames.

en-US.description: OFX plugin that removes dirt and dust from film scans, using the neighbouring frames.
en-US.longDescription:
Advanced Dirt Removal is an OFX plugin for DaVinci Resolve, Nuke and other OFX hosts.
It finds dirt and dust that appear in a single frame and repairs them from the
neighbouring frames, with a recovery mask, auto recovery and difference views for checking.
en-US.name: Advanced Dirt Removal
